search_text: published ZDI-22-322 ZDI-CAN-15118 Schneider Electric IGSS Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2022-02-11 CVE-2022-24315 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-24315 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Schneider Electric'] ['IGSS'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Schneider Electric IGSS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the IGSSDataServer process, which listens on TCP port 12401 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the IGSS application. https://download.schneider-electric.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=SEVD-2022-039-01 https://www.cisa.gov/uscert/ics/advisories/icsa-22-046-01 ['2021-12-15 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2022-02-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2023-09-20 - Advisory Updated'] Vyacheslav Moskvin https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-22-322/
title: Schneider Electric IGSS Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Schneider Electric IGSS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the IGSSDataServer process, which listens on TCP port 12401 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a read past the end of an allocated buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the IGSS application.
